元素周期表 · 这台手机用到的点亮: Periodic table · the elements this phone uses light up
你手里这块玻璃，挖自多少个国家？: How many countries went into the glass in your hand?
它看着只是一块玻璃、一圈金属、一块会亮的屏。拆开它，一层一层数。: It looks like just a sheet of glass, a band of metal and a screen that lights up. Take it apart and count, layer by layer.
在拆解台上它散成十层：盖板、屏幕、中框、主板、芯片、摄像头、扬声器、马达、电池、: On the teardown bench it comes apart into ten layers: cover glass, screen, frame, logic board, chips, cameras, speakers, vibration motor, battery and antennas.
把每一层溶解、送进质谱仪，数出 53 种金属。铁最多，有 16 克；金只有 16: Dissolve each layer, run it through a mass spectrometer, and you count 53 metals. Iron is the most plentiful at 16 g; there are only 16.8 mg of gold—you would need to take apart 60 phones to collect 1 g.
电池里的钴，76% 出自刚果（金）；芯片里的镓，98% 出自中国。很多金属，全世: 76% of the cobalt in the battery comes from the DR Congo; 98% of the gallium in the chips comes from China. For many metals, the whole world relies on one or two countries.
只算每种金属最大的三个产地，这一台手机就连着 28 个国家。现在你来拆：点一层，: Counting only the three largest producers of each metal, this one phone is tied to 28 countries. Now take it apart yourself: tap a layer to see which elements it uses; tap an element to see where it comes from.
